ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (AND( Claim_Balance_Due__c < 0, Claim_Balance_Due__c <> (IF(ISNULL(Due_to_Patient__c), 0, Due_to_Patient__c) + IF(ISNULL(Due_to_Insurance__c), 0, Due_to_Insurance__c) + IF(ISNULL(Interest_Payment__c), 0, Interest_Payment__c)) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Claim Balance Due must equal the sum of Due to Patient, Due to Insurance, and Interest Payment when the Claim Balance Due is not zero.
